models.name: BEAT 70 CAR
models.firmware_note: the addendum names only the model, no technical data
models.spec_source: Kontronik_Beat_70_CAR.pdf (addendum without ratings); no kontronik.com or dealer page for BEAT 70 CAR states cells, voltage or current

automatable_note: A jumper must be fitted on two of the three programming contacts before power is applied and pulled off after the ESC's first tone sequence. The bench has no actuator for the jumper, so a person performs both steps.

manual.action: Fit the jumper on any 2 of the 3 programming contacts.
manual.action_de: Jumper auf 2 beliebige der 3 Programmierkontakte stecken.

manual.action: Pull the jumper off after 2 s or the tone sequence.
manual.action_de: Jumper nach 2 s oder der Tonfolge abziehen.

manual.action: Hands off: wait until the ESC has finished repeating the mode (tones), then tap DONE.
manual.action_de: Nicht berühren: warten, bis der ESC den Modus fertig wiederholt hat (Töne), dann ERLEDIGT tippen.
manual.source: Kontronik_Beat.pdf p.15 (DE), the procedure the CAR sheet refers to

steps: As the BEAT procedure (jumper on, power on, wait 2 s, pull the jumper), programmed like mode 6 of the BEAT: signal count equals the mode number.
Wait for the series of the wanted mode and move the throttle to full.
Mode 8 is programmed like mode 7 with 8 signals and can be combined with modes 2 to 6.

announce.description: The ESC sounds mode 1 as one tone, mode 2 as two tones, and so on, one series after another with a pause between series.

select.description: Throttle to full during the wanted series.

scheme.description: Same procedure as the BEAT. Modes 2 to 6 are car modes that differ in start-up behaviour, faster from 2 to 6. Mode 8 adds forward and reverse.

values.name: Forward / reverse, combinable with modes 2 to 6

notes: The addendum replaces the BEAT mode meanings for modes 2 to 6; use this profile instead of kontronik-beat for the CAR version.

Modes 2 to 6 are programmed like BEAT mode 6, with the stick at motor-off in the middle (Kontronik_Beat_70_CAR.pdf p.1; Kontronik_Beat.pdf p.15). Mode 8 is 'like mode 7' on the CAR sheet and starts in the middle in the BEAT manual (p.17); it is marked mid as well. Modes 1 and 7 start with the stick back.

Modes 2 to 6, programmed like BEAT mode 6, and mode 8 move the stick back after the full-throttle selection (Kontronik_Beat.pdf p.15, p.17): after_select min, made STORE after the selection; the manual gives no time.

After the store the ESC repeats the stored mode as tones (control output, 'Kontrollausgabe'), and the manual disconnects power after it (Kontronik_Beat.pdf p.15 (DE), the procedure the CAR sheet refers to). The step before_power_off holds the run powered until the operator taps DONE. The manual names no lock for a power-off before the end of it.
